items.title: Here's how much bitcoin and the S&P 500 could rally after midterms
items.summary: Both bitcoin and the S&P 500 have historically produced positive returns in a year after midterms. BTC's pattern, however, could also be explained by the four-year halving cycles.

items.title: Bitcoin ETF inflows climb to $176M as BTC rebounds above $80K
items.summary: US spot Bitcoin ETFs drew $286 million over two days, narrowing October's net outflows to $26 million as the Crypto Fear & Greed Index remained neutral.

items.title: Bitcoin Price Rests Near $80,500 as Midterms, Fed Decision Loom
items.summary: Bitcoin price recovered from an early-morning low near $79,400 to trade around $80,500 on Tuesday, holding above $80,000 ahead of this week's Fed decision and the November midterms. This post Bitcoin Price Rests Near $80,500 as Midterms, Fed Decision Loom first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Micah Zimmerman .

items.title: VanEck Launches All-in-One Wealth Builder ETF With Bitcoin Exposure
items.summary: VanEck launched its Wealth Builder ETF (WBMO) on the NYSE, bundling stocks, bonds, gold and indirect bitcoin exposure into one fund for 0.26% a year. This post VanEck Launches All-in-One Wealth Builder ETF With Bitcoin Exposure first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Micah Zimmerman .

items.title: 27-Year-Old Missouri Man Admits Role in Failed Bitcoin Kidnapping Plot
items.summary: A St. Louis man pleaded guilty in Hartford to conspiracy to commit Hobbs Act robbery over a failed August 2024 plot to steal bitcoin from a Connecticut family. This post 27-Year-Old Missouri Man Admits Role in Failed Bitcoin Kidnapping Plot first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Micah Zimmerman .
